The decisive mistake was made by DataVerification_Expert at step 5. It claimed to download the cover and check it manually, but reported no actual inspection. It then asserted that the cover shows the Eiffel Tower, which was wrong. The correct answer of 185 yards corresponds to about 555 feet, the height of the Washington Monument, not the Eiffel Tower. Every later step (the Geography_Expert's 361-yard calculation and the verification) built on this unsupported identification, so the failure originated there.
